trends.name_zh: MCP 进入企业安全与强制管控阶段
trends.name_en: MCP entering enterprise security & enforcement phase
evidence_zh: Cloudflare One Gateway MCP 检测/enforcement GA——`experimental.is_mcp`、仅 Portal 的 enforcement、OAuth 预注册（2026-08-14，一手来源，ev-20260814-03）
Workday Adaptive Planning 第一方 MCP Server 出现在 2026R2 release notes（2026-08-14，官方文档）——企业 SaaS 供给端
Practical DevSecOps《MCP Security Statistics 2026》：82% 的实现存在 path traversal 风险；截至 8 月初已披露 40+ 个 MCP CVE——安全需求端
生态规模：2026-07-28 无状态 spec 修订后 MCP server 总数已超 10,000

背景（已核实）：Netskope Advanced Analytics 的 MCP Security Dashboard 于 2026-06-12 面向所有启用 Advanced Analytics 的客户可用（官方 release notes）；但 22 个 MCP 数据属性仍在 feature flag 之后（需 Sales/Support 开启）——非干净 GA（2026-08-20 核实为覆盖前背景）
evidence_en: Cloudflare One Gateway MCP detection/enforcement GA — `experimental.is_mcp`, Portal-only enforcement, OAuth pre-registration (2026-08-14, primary, ev-20260814-03)
Workday Adaptive Planning first-party MCP Server in 2026R2 release notes (2026-08-14, official docs) — enterprise SaaS supply side
Practical DevSecOps MCP Security Statistics 2026: 82% of implementations vulnerable to path traversal; 40+ disclosed MCP CVEs by early August — security demand side
Ecosystem scale: 10,000+ MCP servers after the 2026-07-28 stateless spec revision

Background (verified): Netskope's MCP Security Dashboard in Advanced Analytics became available to all Advanced Analytics customers on 2026-06-12 (official release notes); however the 22 MCP data attributes remain behind a feature flag (Sales/Support activation) — not a clean GA (verified 2026-08-20 as pre-coverage background)
trends.why_it_matters_zh: 升级依据：来自不同组织、不同日期的多个独立信号（网络厂商、企业 SaaS、安全研究）指向同一方向——MCP 正在从新奇协议转变为受治理的企业基础设施。
trends.why_it_matters_en: Why upgraded: multiple independent signals from different organizations and dates (network vendor, enterprise SaaS, security research) all point the same direction — MCP is moving from novelty protocol to governed enterprise infrastructure.
trends.what_would_confirm_zh: 第二家安全厂商（Zscaler/Netskope/Palo Alto）交付 **GA** 状态的 MCP 识别能力并公开遥测数据；MCP auth spec 在主流 agent framework 中落地
trends.what_would_confirm_en: Second security vendor (Zscaler/Netskope/Palo Alto) shipping **GA** MCP identification with public telemetry; MCP auth spec adoption in major agent frameworks

updates.note_zh: 核查了 Zscaler/Netskope/Palo Alto 是否已交付 MCP 识别能力——未发现（仅见 SASE 选型对比文章与 Zscaler 自有 MCP server 集成）。确认判据仍未满足。Status/Confidence 维持不变。
updates.note_en: Checked Zscaler/Netskope/Palo Alto for MCP identification shipping — none found (only SASE comparison articles and Zscaler's own MCP server integrations). Confirmation criterion still unmet. Status/Confidence unchanged.

updates.note_zh: 背景说明——Netskope 的 MCP 安全能力（实时识别 MCP server/client 及 name/ID/URL/version/host/protocol 属性、CCI 风险评分、default-block 策略、DLP）于 2025-12-01 以 Preview 状态宣布，GA 计划 2026 上半年；未检索到带日期的 GA 公告。能力上部分满足第二家厂商判据，但早于本知识库覆盖范围——仅作为背景登记。补充背景：2026-07-28 MCP auth spec（OAuth 2.1/OIDC）遭企业侧阻力（anonymous DCR 批评）；CSA 在 2026 年初记录约 7,000 个暴露的 MCP server，约半数无认证；NSA/DoD 于 2026 年 6 月发布安全设计指引。判据修正为：第二家安全厂商交付 **GA** 状态的 MCP 识别能力 + 公开遥测。Status/Confidence 维持不变。
updates.note_en: Background note — Netskope's MCP security (real-time MCP server/client identification with name/ID/URL/version/host/protocol attributes, CCI risk scoring, default-block policy, DLP) was announced 2025-12-01 as Preview, GA planned H1 2026; no dated GA announcement found. Partially satisfies the second-vendor criterion on capability, but predates KB coverage — logged as background only. Additional context: 2026-07-28 MCP auth spec (OAuth 2.1/OIDC) faces enterprise pushback (anonymous DCR criticism); CSA catalogued ~7,000 exposed MCP servers in early 2026, ~half unauthenticated; NSA/DoD security design guidance June 2026. Criterion refined to: second security vendor with **GA** MCP identification + published telemetry. Status/Confidence unchanged.

updates.note_zh: 窗口内无新信号；Netskope GA 判据仍未满足（新闻发布页本次不可达，未检索到带日期 GA 公告）。邻接信号（不计为证据）：Codex 0.148.0 的 MCP OAuth 重认证恢复与沙箱 fail-closed 属客户端可靠性加固，非企业级识别/管控。Status/Confidence 维持不变。

Adjacent signal (not counted as evidence): Codex 0.148.0's MCP recovery after OAuth re-auth and sandbox fail-closed are client-side reliability hardening, not enterprise identification/enforcement. Status/Confidence unchanged.

updates.note_zh: 判据核查有实质进展：经 Netskope 官方 release notes（2026-06-12）核实，MCP Security Dashboard 已面向所有启用 Advanced Analytics 的客户可用（包含监控 AI-agent 活动的 dashboard），但 22 个 MCP 数据属性仍需 feature flag + Sales/Support 激活——结论：部分 GA、非干净 GA，确认判据（第二家厂商 GA + 公开遥测）仍未满足。该事实早于本知识库覆盖期，以「已核实背景」计入证据列表。窗口内无其他新信号。Status/Confidence 维持 emerging / Medium。
updates.note_en: Substantive criterion progress: verified via Netskope's official release notes (2026-06-12) that the MCP Security Dashboard is available to all customers with Advanced Analytics enabled (a dashboard for monitoring AI-agent activity), but the 22 MCP data attributes still require a feature flag plus Sales/Support activation — conclusion: partial GA, not a clean GA; the confirmation criterion (second vendor GA + public telemetry) remains unmet. The fact predates KB coverage and is recorded in the evidence list as verified background. No other in-window signals. Status/Confidence stays emerging / Medium.

updates.note_zh: 窗口内无新信号；Netskope 干净 GA 判据仍未满足（未检索到带日期的 GA 公告；2026-06-12 部分GA 状态不变）。邻接信号（不计为证据）：Claude Code 2.1.238 的 stdio MCP 握手顺序修复（server/discover 不再先于 initialize）与 elicitation 对话框修复属客户端可靠性；Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard（agent/MCP/skills 扫描红队工具）上榜 GitHub trending 属社区工具信号。Status/Confidence 维持 emerging / Medium。
updates.note_en: No new in-window signals; the Netskope clean-GA criterion remains unmet (no dated GA announcement found; the 2026-06-12 partial-GA state stands). Adjacent signals (not counted as evidence): Claude Code 2.1.238's stdio MCP handshake-order fix (server/discover no longer precedes initialize) and elicitation-dialog fixes are client-side reliability; Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard (agent/MCP/skills scanning red-team tool) trending on GitHub is a community-tool signal. Status/Confidence stays emerging / Medium.

trends.name_zh: Coding agent 收敛为 multi-agent runtime
trends.name_en: Coding agents converging into multi-agent runtimes

trends.status_note_en: strengthening (upgraded from candidate to emerging on 2026-08-18; upgraded to strengthening on 2026-08-20 — a sixth organization, Anysphere/Cursor, landed new primitive types in a stable product, with cross-org in-window evidence accumulating across consecutive windows)
evidence_zh: Anthropic Claude Code：subagent forking 默认开启 + 跨会话 SendMessage（2026-08-13/14）
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) MIT 开源 agent runtime（2026-08-14）
OpenAI Codex subagents GA——manager agent 并行派生专门 subagent（2026-03-16；官方 @OpenAIDevs 公告，snowflake 时间戳 2026-03-16T20:09Z + 媒体交叉印证；2026-08-18 核实为覆盖前背景）
OpenCode 实验性 background subagents，primary/subagent 结构（v1.14.51，v1.18.x 之前的版本线；2026-08-18 核实为覆盖前背景）

evidence_en: Anthropic Claude Code: default-on subagent forking + cross-session SendMessage (2026-08-13/14)
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) MIT open-source agent runtime (2026-08-14)

OpenAI Codex subagents GA — manager agents spawning specialized subagents in parallel (2026-03-16; official @OpenAIDevs announcement, snowflake timestamp 2026-03-16T20:09Z + media corroboration; verified 2026-08-18 as pre-coverage background)
OpenCode experimental background subagents, primary/subagent structure (v1.14.51, pre-v1.18.x line; verified 2026-08-18 as pre-coverage background)
OpenAI Codex CLI 0.148.0 stable ships `codex exec fork` session forking + async hooks that invoke MCP tools (2026-08-18T22:26Z, primary source, ev-20260818-02)

Gemini CLI main branch hosts packages/a2a-server (A2A protocol server); nightlies 8/14–18 reference a2a-server and SSR Agent (observed 2026-08-19; early indication — not stable, no official announcement)

Cursor's 'Cloud Agents and Cursor Harness Improvements' lands always-on system primitives in the stable product: event-driven Subscriptions (subscribe to PRs/Slack/schedules and wake; auto-drive self-created PRs to completion), VM-per-subagent isolation + swarm, /goal long-lived objectives, non-interrupt steering (2026-08-19, official changelog, ev-20260819-01)

OpenAI Codex CLI 0.149.0 stable ships an interactive agents dashboard (search/start/open/rename/stop tasks — the first fleet-management UI in a stable CLI agent runtime) and `codex queue` (send messages into existing local/remote sessions; queued messages reliably wake idle sessions; duplicate-session-name resolution) (2026-08-20T21:04Z, primary source, ev-20260818-02 update)
trends.why_it_matters_zh: 升级为 strengthening 的依据：等效原语已在六家组织（Anthropic、GitHub/Microsoft、DeepSeek、OpenAI、SST/OpenCode、Anysphere/Cursor）得到核实，时间跨度 2026 年 3 月至 8 月且连续多个窗口均有新的窗口内证据；原语类型也在扩展——从 subagent 派生（3 月）到会话分叉 stable（8/18），再到事件驱动唤醒 + VM-per-subagent 隔离 + 长期目标（8/19，Cursor）。对工程的影响开始具体化：agent 运行时正在获得事件触发、隔离并行与目标持久化能力，编排面从「人发起的会话」转向「常驻系统」。尚未确立（established）的原因：非 Anthropic stable 运行时尚无 inter-agent messaging 类原语（Codex fork 是分叉而非消息；Cursor Subscriptions 是事件源唤醒而非 agent 间消息；Gemini CLI a2a-server 未进 stable）；缺少公开的生产案例与采用遥测。
trends.why_it_matters_en: Why upgraded to strengthening: equivalent primitives are now verified across six organizations (Anthropic, GitHub/Microsoft, DeepSeek, OpenAI, SST/OpenCode, Anysphere/Cursor), persisting March–August 2026 with new in-window evidence in consecutive windows; the primitive types are also widening — from subagent spawning (March) to stable session forking (8/18) to event-driven wake-up + VM-per-subagent isolation + long-lived goals (8/19, Cursor). The engineering impact is becoming concrete: agent runtimes are acquiring event triggering, isolated parallelism and goal persistence, shifting the orchestration plane from human-initiated sessions to resident systems. Not yet established because no inter-agent messaging primitive exists in non-Anthropic stable runtimes (Codex fork is forking, not messaging; Cursor Subscriptions are event-source wake-ups, not agent-to-agent messages; Gemini CLI's a2a-server is not stable), and there are no public production case studies or adoption telemetry.
trends.what_would_confirm_zh: (a) Codex、Cursor、OpenCode 或 Gemini CLI 任一落地跨会话/跨 agent messaging（agent-to-agent 语义）；(b) 社区编排模式收敛到 orchestration-on-CLI（出现事实标准工具或命名模式）；(c) ≥2 个独立组织公开生产案例
trends.what_would_confirm_en: (a) Cross-session/inter-agent messaging (agent-to-agent semantics) landing in Codex, Cursor, OpenCode or Gemini CLI; (b) community orchestration patterns consolidating around orchestration-on-CLI (de-facto standard tool or named pattern); (c) ≥2 independent organizations publishing production case studies

updates.note_zh: 窗口内无新信号（Claude Code 无新版本；Cursor Builds 默认开启时间为 8/17，尚未生效）。
updates.note_en: No new signals in window (no new Claude Code release; Cursor Builds default-on is 8/17, not yet in effect).

updates.note_zh: Cursor Builds 按计划对所有环境默认开启——但 Builds 是 warm-snapshot 基础设施改进，不是 multi-agent 原语；不计为证据。
updates.note_en: Cursor Builds became default-on for all environments as scheduled — but Builds is a warm-snapshot infra improvement, not a multi-agent primitive; not counted as evidence.

updates.note_zh: 新增两条窗口内证据：(a) Codex CLI 0.148.0 stable 落地 `codex exec fork` + 可调用 MCP 工具的异步 hooks（一手来源）；(b) Gemini CLI main 分支出现 packages/a2a-server（A2A 协议 server，nightly 引用）——early indication。判据 (a)（跨会话/跨 agent messaging 落地非 Anthropic stable 运行时）仍未满足：Codex fork 是分叉原语而非消息原语，a2a-server 未进 stable。Status/Confidence 维持不变。
updates.note_en: Two in-window evidence items added: (a) Codex CLI 0.148.0 stable ships `codex exec fork` + async hooks that invoke MCP tools (primary source); (b) Gemini CLI main branch hosts packages/a2a-server (A2A protocol server, referenced by nightlies) — early indication. Criterion (a) (cross-session/inter-agent messaging in a non-Anthropic stable runtime) remains unmet: Codex fork is a forking primitive, not messaging; a2a-server is not stable. Status/Confidence unchanged.

updates.note_zh: 升级为 strengthening：Cursor 8/19 在稳定产品中落地 always-on 系统原语——事件驱动 Subscriptions、VM-per-subagent 隔离 + swarm、/goal、非打断 steering（第六家组织，两类新原语类型；官方 changelog 一手来源）。Anthropic 侧 Claude Code 2.1.236 的 SendMessage `notify_when_idle` 为既有 messaging 原语的细化（同一组织，不另计证据）。判据 (a) 仍未满足：Cursor Subscriptions 是事件源唤醒而非 agent 间消息；Gemini CLI 0.56.0 stable 已发但 a2a-server 未纳入。不升 established（缺公开生产案例与采用遥测），confidence 维持 Medium。
updates.note_en: Upgraded to strengthening: Cursor's 8/19 stable-product release lands always-on system primitives — event-driven Subscriptions, VM-per-subagent isolation + swarm, /goal, non-interrupt steering (sixth organization, two new primitive types; official changelog primary source). On the Anthropic side, Claude Code 2.1.236's SendMessage `notify_when_idle` refines the existing messaging primitive (same organization, not counted separately).
